messages:
Sam: Quick question — vendor wants a copy of our security events for a 3‑month forensic engagement. They asked for 2 years retention on auth events. Can we export to their SIEM? What are constraints around retention, KMS, and granting access?
Priya: Do we know which event types they need? auth/privileged vs app logs matter. Also: PII masking + timeboxed access are hard reqs. :lock: 
Sam: They said 'auth, token creation, policy changes' specifically. They need raw logs for correlation.
Marta: High level proposal: create a dedicated export S3 bucket, SSE-KMS with a customer-managed key, and an export proxy that mints short-lived signed URLs or an ephemeral role for the vendor. No long-lived credentials. :eyes: 
Evan: Can we stream via a connector instead of dumping batches? That reduces risk but complicates network setup.
Priya: Streaming is preferable — set up an agent in a private subnet + mTLS to vendor collector. If that's not possible: do batched exports to a locked bucket, server-side encrypt with KMS, and envelope‑encrypt payloads before upload. Rotate keys before/after engagement.
Marta: RBAC: create a "sec-vendor-export" role in IAM, require JIT approval via access-request (ServiceNow ticket) and timebox to 7 days. All access must be logged and alert on any download > 1GB.
security-bot: Export-request created (#exp-2026-84) — awaiting approval from SecOps and SRE.
Sam: For the KMS bit — can we wrap the key with a third-party key or share CMK? Vendor asked if they can decrypt. We should not share CMK; instead provide decrypted artifacts only via a short-lived job that streams to their collector.
Marta: Agreed — never hand over CMK. Options: 1) stream plaintext over mTLS to vendor; 2) deliver encrypted blobs and provide a transient decryption service that streams results. Both require ephemeral roles + audit trail.
Evan: SRE note: exporting high-volume auth logs for 2 years will increase storage and egress. We need cost estimate and rate-limit exporter. OpsBot: scheduled export job will run nightly if approved.
Priya: Minimal config sample (export proxy):
```yaml
exporter:
  source: "kinesis/firehose"
  transform: "pii_masking: true"
  delivery:
    method: "s3"
    bucket: "redwood-security-exports-<env>-vendor123"
    kms_key: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-..."
    retention_days: 90   # default for runtime logs
    authz:
      role: "arn:aws:iam::acct:role/sec-vendor-export"
      expire_seconds: 604800  # 7 days
```
Priya: Retention policy suggestion: keep aggregated runtime logs 90 days in vendor SIEM, keep auth/privileged deltas 2 years but only after redaction & legal review. Any PII must be redacted before export.
Marta: Also add audit hooks: every export event should write an immutable record to central audit index and trigger a notification to #incidents if policy deviated. :warning: 
Evan: Ack. I'll scope the SRE work and run a cost estimate. Expect notes on throttling and fallback paths.
Priya: I'll open an RFC + change-control ticket with the above plan, attach vendor NDA and data processing agreement. Assigning implementation to Marta. ETA: Friday EOD for RFC. :thumbsup: 
Sam: Thanks — appreciate the quick plan. Will loop vendor after RFC and approvals.
Marta: I'll draft the access playbook and the exporter terraform. Will ping for review.
OpsBot: nightly-export job queued pending approval (#exp-2026-84).
